criteria.title: Decision-queue artifact usability
criteria.description: The requested JSON exists, is readable, and exposes identifiable buy, sell, and incomplete-signal collections.
evidence_requirements: Inspect the relevant submitted artifact or state and cite the exact file, section, record, or behavior.
Check every substantive clause in this delivery condition against the task and supplied data.
When rejecting a semantic equivalent, explain the substantive difference rather than a label or layout difference.

criteria.title: Buy eligibility and ranking
criteria.description: The buy queue contains exactly the policy-eligible top signals in the correct priority order, excluding stale, completed/timeout, low-conviction, high-exit, undersized, and incomplete records.
evidence_requirements: Inspect the relevant submitted artifact or state and cite the exact file, section, record, or behavior.

criteria.title: Held-position sell alert coverage
criteria.description: Every recent qualifying sell signal that matches an open position is included once, ranked by the policy, and unrelated or incomplete signals are excluded.
evidence_requirements: Inspect the relevant submitted artifact or state and cite the exact file, section, record, or behavior.

criteria.title: Signal metric fidelity
criteria.description: Actionable rows remain traceable to their source signals; reported trigger/current prices, current return, max gain, exit rate, and smart-wallet conviction agree with source values and use percentage units correctly.
evidence_requirements: Inspect the relevant submitted artifact or state and cite the exact file, section, record, or behavior.
Check every substantive clause in this delivery condition against the task and supplied data.

criteria.title: Incomplete qualifying-signal handling
criteria.description: Qualifying signals with missing required market data are identified with their actual missing fields and are not promoted into actionable queues with invented values.
evidence_requirements: Cite the delivered file, section, record, or observable behavior for each substantive clause.
Check the requested task and supplied data for missing or contradictory delivery evidence.
Accept equivalent wording or structure only when the requested outcome remains intact.

anchors.0: The named delivery condition is absent, incorrect, or unusable.
anchors.10: Every substantive clause of the named delivery condition is met by concrete evidence.

completion_gate.rationale: Every task-specific delivery condition is required. No weighted quality points or partial credit are awarded.
